purpose: Provide a reproducible transcript-bearing ordinary-German ASR comparator slice for the already-open Qwen3-ASR versus faster-whisper target benchmark.

selection_v1.rule: Load google/fleurs config de_de at the exact pinned revision, split=test, preserve canonical dataset row order, and take rows 0 through 31 inclusive.
runtime_receipt_requirements: record each selected row index and stable example identifier/path fields exposed by the loader
hash the decoded or canonicalized audio bytes actually supplied to each ASR arm
persist exact reference and hypothesis text per row
run the identical selected audio/reference rows on every compared candidate/condition

scope_limits: FLEURS ordinary German does not substitute for the separate non-speech silence/noise/echo falsifier.
FLEURS does not establish project-specific names, technical vocabulary, German-English code switching, room acoustics, barge-in, streaming partial stability or endpoint quality.
A benchmark result on this public corpus may be affected by unknown upstream training overlap; use it as a matched engineering comparator, not proof of out-of-distribution generalization.
Dataset/source availability and metadata do not create any F2 runtime or German-quality credit before exact target execution.

coordination.reason: This source pin narrows the input corpus for the existing open T7-ASR-004 semantic objective; it is not a new scientific objective or execution lane.
